name: Mame Coffee
description: Mame Coffee is an editorial WordPress theme designed for independent specialty coffee roasteries and tasting bars. A sharp square photograph floats over a full-bleed roastery backdrop with the wordmark crossing its corner; columns open with a broken 3 px rule, a round outline arrow and a grey panel with rating bars. Newsreader for headings, Nunito Sans for reading. Works as a standalone informational site or with WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
